data.name: Accounts
data.description: To get the list of available records in the Accounts module.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a page of records from the Zoho CRM Accounts module, with selected account fields. Use it to inspect available account records.
Use for: list accounts, preview account names, retrieve phone numbers, filter returned fields
Not supported: creating, updating, deleting, or retrieving one account

data.name: Invoices
data.description: To get the list of available records in the Invoices module.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a page of records from the Zoho CRM Invoices module with status and total fields. Use it to review available invoices.
Use for: list invoices, check invoice statuses, read invoice totals, preview billing records
Not supported: creating, updating, deleting, or retrieving one invoice

data.name: List all accounts
data.description:
Documentation 📖
See detailed documentation for the List all accounts call in our API Reference.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a paginated list of accounts from the Belvo API, with a page and link parameter. Use it to browse account resources.
Use for: list accounts, paginate account results, retrieve linked accounts, inspect account records
Not supported: creating, updating, deleting, or retrieving transactions

data.name: Timeline
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the audit timeline for a specified Zoho CRM lead within a time range, including selected history details. Use it to review lead activity and changes.
Use for: inspect lead history, review field changes, audit lead activity, sort timeline events
Not supported: changing history, creating timeline events, retrieving non-lead timelines

data.name: List
data.description: Read a page of objects. Control what is returned via the properties query param.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a paginated page of HubSpot CRM objects for a specified object type, with selectable properties and associations. Use it to read CRM records.
Use for: list CRM objects, paginate results, select properties, include associations
Not supported: creating, updating, deleting, or restoring objects

data.name: Inventory templates
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves inventory templates configured in Zoho CRM. Use it to inspect available template resources.
Use for: list inventory templates, inspect template settings, browse configured templates
Not supported: creating, updating, deleting, or applying templates

data.name: Get the list of CRM users
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a list of CRM users through the SignNow API. Use it to inspect available user records.
Use for: list CRM users, browse user records, retrieve user details
Not supported: creating, updating, deleting, or managing user permissions

data.name: Invoices
data.description: To get the Invoices associated with an Account.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves invoices associated with a specified Zoho CRM account, including totals, products, and invoice dates. Use it to review account billing records.
Use for: list account invoices, inspect invoice totals, review products, check invoice dates
Not supported: creating, updating, deleting, or retrieving unrelated invoices

data.name: Get the list of CRM Contacts
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a list of CRM contacts through the SignNow API. Use it to inspect available contact records.
Use for: list CRM contacts, browse contact records, retrieve contact details
Not supported: creating, updating, deleting, or managing contact relationships

data.name: Invoices
data.description: To add new entities to a module.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates new records in the Zoho CRM Invoices module. Use it to add invoice entities to CRM.
Use for: create an invoice, add billing records, add invoice products, record invoice details
Not supported: listing, updating, deleting, or retrieving existing invoices
